subject: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Gomez <sylvia@harbortalent.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority

Hi team,

Following our Q4 capacity planning, I'm requesting approval to open and fill three Go-to-market roles on the sales org plan:

- 2x Account Executives (AE) — mid-market, quota-bearing
- 1x Senior Solutions Engineer (SE) — pre-sales/POC lead

High-level asks:
1) Headcount funding approval for these 3 seats to be added to the FY26 Q4 hiring plan (one AE to replace a ramping rep, one AE as net new).
2) Sign-off on proposed comp bands (attached) so TA can extend offers quickly.
3) Offer authority: approve ability for hiring manager to sign up to 95% of mid OTE without exec sign-off. Anything above moves to VP+ approval.

Attachments: 20261005-gtm-headcount-plan-q4-2026.xlsx (headcount vs. budget), compensation-bands-2026.csv (recommended bands and OTEs).

Initial numbers in the sheet assume hires start first week of November with a 90-day ramp for quota credit. If you want alternate start dates or extended ramp, flag it here.

Next steps: If I get approval by EOD Wednesday (10/07) TA will push offers to our top candidates from Harbor Talent and begin scheduling final interviews for the SE.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifying questions before I sign off:

- Budget: Are the two AE seats fully new headcount (net new) or is one a backfill tied to a replacement requisition? The sheet says one is replacement but I'd like confirmation on headcount delta for our forecast.
- OTE mix: For the AEs, confirm the on-target earnings split (base vs variable). I want to ensure comp bands align with quota cadence and manager leverage.
- Ramp assumptions: 90-day ramp to quota sounds aggressive for mid-market. Can we model a conservative 120-day ramp for financial planning?

If you send a quick updated tab in the sheet with "120d ramp" and a final net-new vs backfill note I can approve the headcount and the offer authority for up to 95% of mid OTE. Anything above that will need VP sign-off.

Marissa
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority

Marissa / Jordan —

Uploaded an updated tab to the sheet that models both 90d and 120d ramp scenarios (link in thread). Key notes from comp bands CSV:

- AE (Mid-market)
  - Base: $75,000 - $95,000
  - OTE: $150,000 - $190,000
  - Recommended initial offers: within 90% - 95% of mid OTE for prioritize candidates

- Senior Solutions Engineer
  - Base: $140,000 - $165,000
  - Target total comp: $160,000 - $200,000 depending on signing level / equity

Rationales:
- Bands reflect current competitive data and internal leveling. SE band includes a narrow candidate premium buffer given the POC workload and cross-functional support.
- If we commit to 120d ramp, the financial impact for Q4 reduces slightly (~$45k savings across two AEs) which helps fund a stronger signing bonus for the SE if we need it.

I also attached a CSV (compensation-bands-2026.csv) with band midpoints and recommended offer ranges. TA should use the conservative midpoint when structuring initial offers unless Marissa signs off for premium offers.

Ava
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Sylvia Gomez <sylvia@harbortalent.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority

Looping in TA notes and timelines. Short bullets:

- Candidates: Harbor Talent has 3 pre-screened AE candidates and 2 SEs (one strong, one backup). Sylvia (cc'd) can expedite interviews.
- Offer authority: TA recommends 90% of mid OTE as standard signing. Anything between 90-95% requires manager justification; >95% routed to Marissa for VP approval.
- Background checks and start dates: we need offer windows to be 5 business days to keep momentum; target start date for all hires is 11/02 but flexible based on notice.
- Req IDs: I created provisional reqs: REQ-2026-AE-112, REQ-2026-AE-113, REQ-2026-SE-58. TA needs green light to post or convert to internal backfill.

If we get sign-off by EOD Wednesday, I can issue offers by Thursday and (assuming acceptances) lock start dates in early November.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority

Thanks all — quick finance/people ops confirmation:

- Budget: Finance confirmed budget coverage for two net-new seats and one replacement under code HC-Q4-2026-GTM. I will push the headcount into the HRIS once Marissa confirms net-new vs backfill on the AE roles.
- Equity budgets: We have a small discretionary pool for SE signing grants; please list target equity % with your offer recommendation.
- Compliance / I9: For external hires we need verified documents within 3 business days of offer acceptance.

Mina will finalize the job codes after I get Marissa's confirmation and will stamp requisitions for TA to convert to live postings.

Mina Haddad
People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Gomez <sylvia@harbortalent.com>, Kenji Ito <kito@cloudpartners.io>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Approval for 3 GTM hires + comp bands and offer authority

Update and ask for formal approvals:

- Net-new vs backfill: Confirmed — 1 net-new AE (REQ-2026-AE-113), 1 backfill AE (REQ-2026-AE-112), 1 SE (replacement-conversion REQ-2026-SE-58).
- Ramp: We will assume the conservative 120d ramp for forecasting. Ava — please keep the 90d scenario in the sheet for upside modeling.
- Offer bands: Approve comp bands as uploaded. Offer authority: Marissa approved manager-level sign-off up to 95% of mid OTE; >95% requires VP sign-off.

Approvals requested: Please reply with one-line approval so TA can proceed with offers this week.

- Marissa Cole — please confirm headcount and offer authority approval
- Ava Chen — confirm comp band approval for these roles
- Mina Haddad — confirm budget push and req stamp once Marissa confirms

Thanks — will proceed on acceptances.

Jordan
Director, Solutions Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> replied: APPROVED (headcount, offer authority up to 95% mid OTE).
Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com> replied: Comp bands approved; noted SE discretionary equity.
Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> replied: Budget code HC-Q4-2026-GTM pushed; reqs posted pending TA action.
